data.note: Historical snapshots store best ask only (~5 times per 5-minute window), with no bid or depth and no 1-second price path. Replay fills at the recorded ask with a 50-share single level (fees exact, slippage beyond the touch = 0). momentum_late and latency_hunter cannot be evolved fairly on this history. Richer per-round snapshots (top-of-book levels, bids, short price path) are now recorded going forward.
